home.title: Original Interest-Based Prints & Gifts
home.heading: Prints for people with a thing
home.description: Original print designs for developers, pet owners, gamers, crafters, foodies and more, available as t-shirts and other products on the marketplaces.

intro: Original prints for every kind of enthusiast
description: Browse original designs by interest, from coding and pets to crafts and travel, then pick a t-shirt or other product for yourself or as a gift.

collectionPages.title: Abstract Pattern Shirts & Art Prints
collectionPages.heading: Abstract Pattern Prints
collectionPages.description: Gradient waves, arched rainbow stripes, stained-glass colour and monochrome camo: abstract patterns for people who let colour do the talking.
collectionPages.intro: Colour-first designs with no slogan to explain: gradient waves, watercolor stripes, stained-glass shapes and a black-and-grey camo. They go with almost any outfit, which makes them a safe gift for a friend who loves art but not words on a shirt.

collectionPages.title: AI Humor Shirts & Tech Gifts
collectionPages.heading: AI Reality Check Prints
collectionPages.description: Funny AI designs about wrappers, prompt injection, local models and vacation plans an algorithm made, for people who still double-check the output.
collectionPages.intro: From a stochastic parrot and a spicy autocomplete to an AI-planned trip that ended in chaos, these prints poke gentle fun at the hype. For anyone who uses AI daily and has opinions, and a good pick for a tech colleague or a partner who talks about models at dinner.

collectionPages.title: Back to School Shirts & Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Back to School Prints
collectionPages.description: School-season designs with pencils, snack priorities and AI study buddies, for students, teachers and parents surviving the new term.
collectionPages.intro: Fresh pencils, doodle margins, a backpack with academic ambitions and a robot lab partner who needs a hall pass. Wear one on the first day, or give it to a student, a teacher or a parent who has the supply list memorised.

collectionPages.title: Debugging & Bug Humor T-Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Bugs and Hallucinations
collectionPages.description: Rubber-duck debugging, regression jokes and AI that is confidently wrong: shirts for developers who live with stack traces.
collectionPages.intro: A cat that says the API exists in its imagination, a bug with a long history, and a request for the error text instead of a screenshot. Made for developers and QA folks, and a fit for a teammate's birthday or a farewell gift.

collectionPages.title: Vibe Coding Shirts & Prompt Humor
collectionPages.heading: Prompts and Vibe Coding
collectionPages.description: Context windows, token limits and one more prompt before bed: humorous prints for people who build with AI assistants.
collectionPages.intro: Typography and retro cartoons about forgetting the first prompt, hitting a rate limit and shipping something that probably works. For vibe coders and prompt tinkerers, and a friendly gift for whoever always says just one more prompt.

collectionPages.title: Dynamic Sports & Motion Art Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Dynamic Fluid Art
collectionPages.description: Skiers, cyclists, racers and paddleboarders drawn in swirling abstract colour, for people who love speed, sport and movement.
collectionPages.intro: Athletes and vehicles caught mid-motion inside bold swirls: a skier, a parkour jump, a motorcycle, a go-kart and a sports car. Take it to the gym or the track, or give it to a friend whose weekends are all about getting outside.

collectionPages.title: Funny Coder Shirts & Dev Humor
collectionPages.heading: Everyday Dev Humor
collectionPages.description: Programming-language jokes, rubber ducks with API keys and meetings AI could attend, for the developer who laughs at their own stack.
collectionPages.intro: Typographic jokes about indentation, ownership issues and packages that do not exist, plus a few cartoon robots and ducks. The in-jokes are for people who code, which is what makes them a good gift for a developer on your team.

collectionPages.title: Family & Friends Gathering Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Family and Friends
collectionPages.description: Grandma crowns, Thanksgiving casseroles, Halloween group costumes and Christmas tables with room for one more, for the people you celebrate with.
collectionPages.intro: Designs about the crowd around the table: grandmas with crowns, cousins on candy duty, matching pajamas and a group chat in Christmas sweaters. Pick one for a family gathering, a friends' holiday or a grandparent who deserves the title.

collectionPages.title: Foodie Shirts & Food Lover Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Food Lover Prints
collectionPages.description: Ramen, pasta, chili, sourdough starter and strong coffee, with a sense of humour, for home cooks, bakers and anyone who lives to eat.
collectionPages.intro: Cheerful food characters and kitchen puns, from a miso soup cup and a gym-going avocado to a sourdough starter with weekend plans. Wear it to the table, or give it to the friend who always picks the restaurant and knows what to order.

collectionPages.title: Gamer Shirts & Geek Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Gamers and Geeks
collectionPages.description: Controller astronauts, a broken escape key, a Go board and haunted tabletop jokes: designs for gamers and puzzle-loving geeks.
collectionPages.intro: For the people who say just one more level, from a shattered Game Over screen to a minimalist Go board and dice-rolling ghosts. A good gift for a partner or friend who games, and low-key enough to wear outside the living room.

collectionPages.title: Mindfulness Shirts & Wellness Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Health and Wellness
collectionPages.description: Easy-pace walks, rest days and care on the calendar, plus calm-down slogans and plant art, for people who put wellbeing on the list.
collectionPages.intro: Gentle prints about asking for help, stretching a little, taking the conversational pace and letting plants do the healing. Wear them to yoga or a slow Sunday, or send one to a friend who could use a reminder to rest.

collectionPages.title: Hobby Club Shirts & Craft Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Hobby Club Prints
collectionPages.description: Beading, knitting, candle making, aquariums, ham radio, climbing, curling and more: humorous club-style prints for people with a serious hobby.
collectionPages.intro: Inside jokes for people who pour candles, string pony beads, keep fish tanks, true bicycle wheels, fly model rockets or turn wooden bowls. Choose the exact hobby for a gift that proves you noticed, or a club badge for a whole crew.

collectionPages.title: Holiday & Festival Shirts and Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Holidays and Festivals
collectionPages.description: Thanksgiving, Halloween, Black Friday and Christmas designs, plus festival and fiesta art, for people who love a seasonal celebration.
collectionPages.intro: A year of occasions: a turkey flock out for a run, gingerbread ambition, a sale-rack romance, Christmas-cheer-with-minimal-effort and fiesta or flamenco art. Good for hosts, Secret Santa swaps and anyone with a favourite festival.

collectionPages.title: Human in the Loop Shirts for Devs
collectionPages.heading: Humans in the Loop
collectionPages.description: Trust but verify the diff: shirts about reviewing the robot's work, for developers who stay accountable for what AI ships.
collectionPages.intro: Terminal emblems, comics and blueprints about reviewing an agent's pull request, asking who debugs the AI and explaining what the bot shipped. For engineers who check the work, and a thoughtful gift for a code-review-minded colleague.

collectionPages.title: Kawaii Shirts & Cute Animal Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Kawaii Prints
collectionPages.description: Cute robots, pastel pixels and bubbly animal friends set off on little adventures: kawaii designs for fans of soft, cheerful characters.
collectionPages.intro: Tiny bots with passport stamps, error 404 cuteness and a pastel dream of travel, alongside a bubble print of animal friends. A friendly pick for a travel-loving friend, a younger relative or anyone who collects cute things.

collectionPages.title: Homelab & Self-Hosting Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Localhost and Local AI
collectionPages.description: Home servers, tokens per second and It's Always DNS: pixel art and graphics for self-hosters who run their own machines.
collectionPages.intro: Server racks in the cabin, blinking lights that are normal, and a GPU-poor llama who came for privacy. For homelab fans and local-AI tinkerers, and a clear in-joke gift for the friend who maintains the family server.

collectionPages.title: Love Shirts & Couple Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Love and Relationships
collectionPages.description: Couple designs about shared fries, borrowed hoodies and clear boundaries, for partners who like romance with a sense of humour.
collectionPages.intro: Warm, funny lines for two: flirting in grocery lists, separate dessert orders, same team but different blanket needs. Suited to Valentine's Day or an anniversary, for a partner who prefers playful over mushy.

collectionPages.title: Mental Health Awareness Shirts & Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Mental Health Prints
collectionPages.description: Soft, supportive designs about worth, pace and big feelings, made for people who want a kinder message to wear or share.
collectionPages.intro: Quiet reminders such as a softer inner voice, a day with some pauses and worth that does not clock in. Wear one for yourself, or give it to someone you care about as a gentle sign that you are on their side.

collectionPages.title: Cute Monster Shirts & Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Monster Prints
collectionPages.description: Furry monsters with big teeth and tiny social batteries, from Monday-weary roars to haunters who always knock first.
collectionPages.intro: Characters with plenty of fang and plenty of heart: a monster who packed your nightmare a lunch, one whose roar can wait until Monday, and a third eye that needs a break. Fun for adults and kids who like their creatures cute and a bit introverted.

collectionPages.title: Open Source Shirts & Maintainer Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Open Source, Together
collectionPages.description: Your first PR, contributions welcome and kindness in code reviews: shirts for contributors, maintainers and people still learning.
collectionPages.intro: Community-minded prints about maintainers being volunteers, good first issues and reading CONTRIBUTING.md. Wear it to a meetup, or thank a maintainer or a mentor with a design that says why open source works.

collectionPages.title: Nature Lover & Birdwatcher Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Outdoors and Nature Prints
collectionPages.description: Mushroom foragers, early birders and woodland trail walkers in linocut and field-guide style, for people happiest outside.
collectionPages.intro: Gone looking for little brown mushrooms, one more bird before breakfast, a boot path through the woods. A fitting gift for a forager, a birdwatcher or a hiker who rarely makes it home by dusk.

collectionPages.title: Pet Lover Shirts & Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Pet Lover Prints
collectionPages.description: Cats, dogs and holiday-season pets who have opinions about the tree, for owners whose animals run the entire house.
collectionPages.intro: Prints about the rituals of living with animals: a cat with notes on your tree, a dog who believes Santa delivers snacks, gifts wrapped with love and opened with teeth. A safe pick for a fellow pet person at Christmas or any day.

collectionPages.title: Photographer Shirts & Creator Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Photo and Video Prints
collectionPages.description: Prompts, keyframes and RAW talent: witty designs for photographers, filmmakers and stock creators working alongside AI.
collectionPages.intro: Jokes about shooting RAW while AI does magic, a timeline with an AI problem and a passive income that is very active. A suitable gift for a photographer in the family or a coworker who is always filming something.

collectionPages.title: Programming Shirts & Developer Gifts
collectionPages.heading: Programming Prints
collectionPages.description: Language jokes, hiring-process humour and AI-agent typography for programmers, with a wide range of designs to choose from.
collectionPages.intro: The broadest developer collection: Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and Rust jokes in bold type, plus agents, tokens and open-source habits. A broad starting point when you want a gift for a developer and are not sure which language they use.

collectionPages.title: README & Repo Explorer Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Repo Explorers
collectionPages.description: Vintage trail badges, astronauts and README love for developers who explore open-source repositories like an expedition.
collectionPages.intro: Outdoor-style badges and explorer graphics about reading the README, checking the licence and finding your next fork. A calm, curious look for developers who also like hiking, and a neat gift for a friend who bookmarks too many repos.

collectionPages.title: DevOps & Side Project Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Small Builds, Calm Ops
collectionPages.description: Boring deploys, green pipelines and quiet side projects: relaxed shirts for developers and ops folks who value calm.
collectionPages.intro: Designs about read-only Fridays, tested backups, cosy dotfiles and building something useful and small. For people who like their systems quiet, and a kind gift for a teammate or a new engineer shipping a first release.

collectionPages.title: US State Sunset Shirts & Gifts
collectionPages.heading: US State Sunset Prints
collectionPages.description: Sunset graphics for California, Texas, Florida, New York, Ohio and other states, for people who love where they live or grew up.
collectionPages.intro: Sunset designs, each built around a state's landscape or skyline. Wear your home state, or give one to a relative who has moved away, a graduate or a friend who is proud of where they are from.

collectionPages.title: Travel & Adventure Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Travel and Trips Prints
collectionPages.description: Camping humour, scenic detours, Christmas-market suitcases and AI-planned adventures, for people who are happiest on the move.
collectionPages.intro: Being lost on purpose, a sleigh with a boarding pass, a tiny camper with full-size Christmas spirit and a vacation an algorithm booked. A good gift for a hiker, a holiday traveller or a friend about to leave on a trip.

collectionPages.title: Cybersecurity Humor Shirts
collectionPages.heading: Trust Boundaries Prints
collectionPages.description: Prompt injection, slopsquatting and threat-modeling jokes for security-minded developers and anyone who guards the system prompt.
collectionPages.intro: Warning signs and graphics about keeping secrets out of commits, not trusting user input and packages that do not exist. For security engineers and the developers who sit next to them.

faq.question: When should I order, and who handles shipping?
faq.answer: Ordering and shipping cut-offs are set by Redbubble and TeePublic and shown on their product pages. Check the delivery estimate there before you order.

faq.question: Are there sales or special prices?
faq.answer: Any promotions are set by the marketplaces, not by this site, and nothing here guarantees one. Prices, sizes and colours are shown on each marketplace page.

faq.question: How do I choose a Halloween gift?
faq.answer: Pick the kind of spooky the person enjoys: cute, funny or nerdy. Designs that read as playful rather than scary are easier to wear beyond October. This site does not offer costumes, so check the marketplace for the products available.
